pages.text: $(t3)Tier 3$() unlocks $(bold)Mekanism$(): osmium ore stops showing as plain stone, and the full machine roster opens. Its keystone reward is $(bold)5x ore$(): a four-stage chain turns one ore into five ingots' worth of output. In order, the stages are $(bold)Enrichment, Purification, Injection, Crystallization$().

pages.title: Feeding the Chain
pages.text: The 5x chain is power-hungry, and the scalable T3 answer is $(bold)ethylene$(): farmed crops go to Bio Fuel, then through a Pressurized Reaction Chamber into a Gas-Burning Generator. You will all but need automated farming, and that is by design.

pages.title: Banking T3 Tokens
pages.text: Mekanism is the densest token tier. A $(bold)Gas-Burning Generator$() banks $(t3)100$(), a Basic Smelting Factory $(t3)80$(), a Purification Chamber $(t3)70$() and an Enrichment Chamber $(t3)60$().$(br2)Bank $(t3){{tier 3 threshold}}$() in total to reach $(t4)Tier 4$(). Full writeup: $(l:icraft:mods_t3/mekanism)Mekanism$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Next: get ethylene burning before you scale the chain.$()
